title: Scientists turned waste wool into stiff building panels that helped reduce heat transfer
summary_full: Researchers have found an innovative way to repurpose waste wool fibers into building panels. The panels, formed with keratin and citric acid, provide excellent insulation properties. Existing wool that is typically discarded can now be used in construction. This development addresses significant waste in the wool industry while promoting sustainability. The findings present an alternative to traditional building materials, enhancing eco-friendly construction practices.
